results.title: Let Me Tell You, Dad
results.overview: The story of a circus performer and his son on the journey to find lost connection.

results.title: Middling
results.overview: Two class (and soul) mates unravel across time, space, and mediocre diner french fries.

results.title: Rodnee
results.overview: Rodnee is a broken schizophrenic consumed by drug-fueled binges and uncontrollable masturbation. His mind is over-crowded by disturbing hallucinations that manifest his traumas and most painful regrets as undefinable and monstrous pseudo-realities that constantly push him further off the edge of sanity.

results.title: Puppygirl
results.overview: A semi-delusional trans woman embarks on a shocking, bizarre, and oddly touching personal odyssey to undo years of sexual repression by performing in puppygirl fetish porn.

results.title: Gaia
results.overview: Seriously injured in the most important match of her MMA career, Gaia returns to her estranged family for rest and rehab. While there, she is torn between returning to the fight game or staying to support her family.

results.title: DreamScape
results.overview: DreamScape is a Science Fiction Coming-of-Age Drama that follows a lonely teenager who discovers a revolutionary virtual reality device capable of creating perfect dream worlds. At first, DreamScape offers him an escape from the pressures and disappointments of real life, allowing him to live out his greatest fantasies. But as he becomes increasingly dependent on the technology, disturbing side effects begin to emerge.

results.title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Fedi Nuril
results.original_title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Fedi Nuril
results.overview: Actor Fedi Nuril takes the hot seat as he faces hilarious jokes from a panel of six comedians and celebrities through the “Trilogy of Laughter”.

results.title: The Match That Changed Tennis
results.overview: The epic duel between Djokovic and Nadal, showcasing their physical brilliance, mental resilience and emotional intensity. Explore how this match raised the bar for physical and mental demands in tennis, and inspired upcoming players.

results.title: BAR BOO
results.overview: Through different testimonials from well-known industry figures, such as Enrique López Lavigne, Marta Medina, and Gustavo Salmerón, we delve into the world starring Luis Bar Boo, the man who turned Conan into a barbarian, who was shot dead by Clint Eastwood, who fell from the top of a lighthouse after being pushed by Kirk Douglas, who rode alongside Sean Connery, who challenged Timothy Dalton... and yet, despite all this, nobody knows him.

results.title: The Possible Cinema
results.overview: Judoka, filmmaker, producer and cultural organizer Cavi Borges has built a career driven by the same restless energy on and off the mat. The documentary follows his path from sport to cinema and shows how he became a central figure in Brazilian independent filmmaking, producing films, creating spaces and connecting artists. Between fights, film sets and international festivals, a portrait emerges of someone who turns limitations into momentum and makes another way of producing cinema possible.

results.title: The Tale of Fairy Tales
results.overview: Modern-day Ivan dislikes fairy tales and doesn't believe in them. One day, he accidentally falls into a magic chest and finds himself in a world of fairy tales. To return home, Ivan must confront evil spirits, make friends, and accomplish a truly heroic feat.

results.title: Бэркэ
results.overview: The small village of Khatystyr in the forests of southern Yakutia has long been considered the land of the Evenki. Recently, popular ethnobloggers have emerged here, sharing stories of Tungus culture with hundreds of thousands of followers online. Timofey Ivanovich is over sixty. He is a wolf hunter, and so he adopted the online pseudonym Berke (Evenk for "wolf"). Berke is an old-timer, a keeper of traditions, respected and called upon at crucial moments. Now such a moment has arrived: the wolves have returned. Hungry packs are crushing reindeer and moving toward the village. Berke ventures alone into the taiga to drive off the predators. In his real world, he has only a rifle and a video camera. And in his virtual world, there are millions of views and thousands of comments. This is the story of how a keeper of national myths saves his small people from the scourge of wolves, and ultimately becomes a new folk legend himself.

results.title: Accused: The Karen Read Story
results.overview: When police officer John O'Keefe is found dead, his girlfriend, Karen Read, is charged in connection with his death. What begins as a shocking tragedy quickly ignites a firestorm that captures national attention as Karen fights to clear her name.

results.title: The Site
results.overview: Vincent works the night shift on the construction site of a futuristic district. When a worker goes missing, Vincent and his colleagues suspect that their superiors are covering up an accident. But soon another worker disappears.

results.title: Baby/Girls
results.overview: Set in post-Dobbs Arkansas, baby/girls follows three teens living in a Christian maternity home as they navigate pregnancy and early motherhood. The film offers an intimate, unfiltered look at girlhood and motherhood colliding in the American South.
